title: Reuse rule library of the template route (RTL -> ISA refinement): normalizations, layer generators, generic lemmas, proof strategies
doc: Each rule = pattern (executable applicability check, tools/cpu_rule_patterns.py:<function>, on the imported AST + manifest WITHOUT its route section) + content (generic Coq libraries / generator + options) + instantiate (how the driver tools/cpu_tmpl_route.py --match-rules/--apply-rules turns a match into route fields or stages) + learned_from / reused_by (from framework/template-route-ledger.json and the design logs). `match` says which already-built modules a rule produced (used by tools/cpu_rule_metrics.py). `reused_by` lists only reuse that the ledger/logs/module Requires show; independent re-implementations are listed under `reimplemented_by`. Log: proof-optimization-log/20261104-rule-library.md.

kinds.normalization: rewrites the input (frontend) or fixes a convention field before the layers are generated
kinds.layer_generator: generator that emits a whole route layer from AST + manifest roles (output automatic)
kinds.generic_lemma: design-independent Coq library consumed by generators
kinds.proof_strategy: choice of a proof engine / proof shape / speed-up for a layer

obligations: (R) the pad lane 31 (= register x0) is only read in a dead ECond arm
(W) writes to the pad lane are never observed

rules.name: edge_fast_filter

pattern.description: selection lemmas cost ~ n_seq * n_processes; above 3000 use the computed process-index filter

rules.calibration: threshold 3000 separates the measured cases: bzeeno 7x270=1890 (11 s plain), srv32 16x90=1440 (25 s), angelo5fix 9x264=2376 (12 s), steel 22x210=4620 (1006 s plain), nerv 18x550=9900 (used --fast-filter). Fitted on these points only.

checked_on.evidence: ledger bz-edge-a3-fastfilter: re-gate of the option on Bzeeno (14.9 s, same 17 statements); Bzeeno's accepted chain uses edge a2 without it
